instruction: find the {object} by turning your waist, without walking, and point at it with your right arm. Then keep pointing at it until you are told to stop: listen about 5 seconds at a time, and after each listen look at the image and the measured aim, and point again whenever the arm is off the {object}. If you cannot find it after looking around, say so and give up. When you are told to stop, lower your arm and finish with done

object.note: what to point at, as the person named it (a water bottle, the red chair, the teacher's laptop)

safety_notes: Do not walk in this task: search with the waist and point with the right arm only.
notes: Point at whatever is asked and keep pointing until told to stop (said, or typed in g1 start while it runs; Esc stops it at once): the model re-checks the aim after each short listen and re-points when off (the model is the loop; no tool watches the camera). g1 start fills {object} from the request ("point at the water bottle": the model's run_task object, or /task point_at water bottle). g1 run point_at uses the default, the laptop, in point_at_the_laptop's scene, scored by the twin; in sim a voice says stop after 60 s. Budget: 300 decisions or 30 min, whichever first (a guess). Robot: the object within the waist's reach of view (in front, up to about 90 degrees either side), not too far to see.
